id: title:GeneralistDev:render notes and app resilience for mcp ui apps

observations.behavior: Adds try-catch around PostHog client construction and registration in P3 to prevent iframe sandbox failures from breaking the entire MCP UI app.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes PostHog initialization resilient; if localStorage access fails or registration errors occur, the app continues without throwing.

observations.behavior: Adds an opt-in footer note distinguishing results already rendered as interactive views, while also collecting token counts for structured content and footers separately.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes response payload structure used by downstream consumers; could affect how PostHog-compatible clients parse responses or estimate costs.

observations.behavior: Updates tests to account for new token estimation behavior including both structuredContent and footers when includeRenderNote is set.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests do not demonstrate a benefit but show implementation of the changed behavior. No score increase based on this hunk alone.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks reviewed out of many; no complete end-to-end execution test coverage shown. The change does not modify PostHog ingestion or retention paths directly.

review.limitations: Only three hunks reviewed out of many; no complete end-to-end execution test coverage shown. The change does not modify PostHog ingestion or retention paths directly.
review.reason: The patch adds a bounded capability: it makes PostHog client initialization fail-safe against common browser security restrictions in sandboxed iframes, preserving UI availability rather than crashing. It also introduces a small behavioral change to response payloads (adding render notes) with corresponding token accounting. This is substantive and visible, but lacks broader systemic risk reduction across multiple critical components.
review.posthog_relevance: Makes PostHog-dependent MCP UI apps more reliable in restrictive environments; changes response metadata that may be consumed by compatible clients.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies only on provided chunk; full dependency graph and runtime behavior are unknown.
